title: Trusted sources improve push quality
content: Prefer trusted source domains when ranking industry news candidates because source quality reduces noisy pushes.

push_rules: prefer trusted source domains when scores are close

title: Candidate scoring should combine relevance and source trust
content: Score candidates by topic relevance, evidence quality, and trusted source alignment before pushing a summary.

push_rules: penalize weak evidence or noisy summaries
history_guidance: avoid repeating already-pushed angles within cooldown

title: Article extraction should keep concise summaries
content: Extract a concise article summary and stable keywords so later steps can evaluate the candidate consistently.
